_meta.name: MikroTik RouterOS CVE Reference Database
_meta.note: Kurasi manual dari sumber publik (NVD, VulnCheck, MikroTik Security Advisories) untuk keperluan skripsi. Perbarui berkala dari https://mikrotik.com/supportsec dan https://nvd.nist.gov sebelum dipakai pada laporan resmi. Skema atribut mengikuti Tabel 3.2 Perancangan Basis Data (BAB III).

schema.title: String - Nama umum/singkat kerentanan
schema.affected_ports: Array[Integer] - Port terkait layanan yang rentan
schema.affected_version: String - Rentang versi terdampak, format: '<= X', '>= X', 'X - Y', atau gabungan beberapa cabang dipisah ';' (mis. 'stable: 6.27 - 6.49.6; long-term: <= 6.49.7')
schema.severity_level: String - Tingkat keparahan: Low, Medium, High, Critical
schema.vulnerability_type: String - Kategori serangan (mis. Privilege Escalation, DoS, RCE, Brute Force)
schema.description: Text - Penjelasan singkat mekanisme celah keamanan

cves.title: An issue in MikroTik RouterOS v
cves.description: An issue in MikroTik RouterOS v.7.14.2 and SwOS v.2.18 exposes the WebFig management interface over cleartext HTTP by default, allowing an on-path attacker to execute injected JavaScript in the administrator’s browser and intercept credentials.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: MikroTik firmware 7
cves.description: MikroTik firmware 7.19.4 stores sensitive authentication credentials and network state in cleartext within non-volatile storage. An attacker with physical access to the device can extract this material from an SPI flash dump, without authenticating to the device and without knowledge of the administrative password.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.description:

cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: MikroTik RouterOS 6
cves.description: MikroTik RouterOS 6.40.5, the SMB service contains a memory corruption vulnerability. Remote, unauthenticated attackers can exploit this issue by sending specially crafted packets, triggering a null pointer dereference. This leads to a Remote Denial of Service (DoS), rendering the SMB service unavailable.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: Winbox Username Enumeration (Timing Side-Channel)
cves.description: Perbedaan waktu respons dan ukuran payload antara percobaan login dengan username valid vs tidak valid memungkinkan penyerang melakukan enumerasi akun pengguna yang sah, mempermudah serangan brute-force lanjutan.
cves.mitigation_hint: Upgrade ke versi RouterOS terbaru yang sudah memperbaiki celah ini. Batasi akses Winbox hanya dari IP tepercaya dan aktifkan penguncian akun setelah beberapa kali percobaan gagal.

cves.title: Lack of TLS validation in plugin MikroTik on Checkmk Exchange
cves.description: Improper Certificate Validation in Checkmk Exchange plugin MikroTik allows attackers in MitM position to intercept traffic. This issue affects MikroTik: from 2.0.0 through 2.5.5, from 0.4a_mk through 2.0a.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: regreSSHion – OpenSSH Race Condition RCE
cves.affected_version: OpenSSH: 8.5p1 - 9.7p1 (perlu verifikasi manual versi OpenSSH yang dipakai daemon SSH perangkat)
cves.description: Race condition pada signal handler OpenSSH server yang berpotensi menghasilkan eksekusi kode arbitrer dengan hak akses root.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui OpenSSH ke >= 9.8p1, atau nonaktifkan layanan SSH bila tidak diperlukan.

cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: crypto: safexcel - Cleanup ring IRQ workqueues on load failure
cves.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

crypto: safexcel - Cleanup ring IRQ workqueues on load failure

A failure loading the safexcel driver results in the following warning
on boot, because the IRQ affinity has not been correctly cleaned up.
Ensure we clean up the affinity and workqueues on a failure to load the
driver.

crypto-safexcel: probe of f2800000.crypto fail
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: MikroTik WinBox 3
cves.description: MikroTik WinBox 3.22 and below stores the user's cleartext password in the settings.cfg.viw configuration file when the Keep Password field is set and no Master Password is set. Keep Password is set by default and, by default Master Password is not set. An attacker with access to the configuration file can extract a username and password to gain access to the router.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: MikroTik WinBox before 3

WinBox is vulnerable to this attack if it connects to a malicious endpoint or if an attacker mounts a man in the middle attack.

cves.title: RouterOS versions 6
cves.affected_version: <= RouterOS 6.45.6 Stable and below. RouterOS 6.44.5 Long-term and below.
cves.description: RouterOS versions 6.45.6 Stable, 6.44.5 Long-term, and below are vulnerable to a DNS unrelated data attack. The router adds all A records to its DNS cache even when the records are unrelated to the domain that was queried. Therefore, a remote attacker controlled DNS server can poison the router's DNS cache via malicious responses with additional and untrue records.
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: RouterOS versions 6

cves.description: RouterOS versions 6.45.6 Stable, 6.44.5 Long-term, and below allow remote unauthenticated attackers to trigger DNS queries via port 8291. The queries are sent from the router to a server of the attacker's choice. The DNS responses are cached by the router, potentially resulting in cache poisoning
cves.mitigation_hint: Perbarui firmware MikroTik RouterOS ke versi terbaru resmi (mikrotik.com/download) dan terapkan aturan firewall ketat pada port manajemen.

cves.title: RouterOS 6
cves.affected_version: <= RouterOS 6.45.6 Stable and below. RouterOS 6.44.5 Long-term and below.

cves.title: SOCKS Proxy SSRF / Firewall Bypass
